sections.evidence_strands:
**Instrumented**

- **Paper cohorts (4 tracks):** rules, ai_judgment (primary), momentum_grace, technical — all `acted=true` in `learning_tracks_summary`. Positions: rules/ai_judgment 3 each; momentum_grace 5; technical 3 with `cash_fraction=0.707`.
- **Churn guards active:** all tracks use `exit_confirm_screens=2`, `reentry_cooldown_screens=1`, `min_rebalance_notional_gbp=10.0` (`churn_health.tracks.*.guards`). Last 7d: rules and ai_judgment each 6 trades (3 buys, 3 sells, 3 full_exits); momentum_grace 5 buys/0 sells; technical 3 buys/0 sells. `adjacent_flip_count=0` on all tracks.
- **Decision-review counterfactual previews:** rules — `scope=rebalance_log_replay`, `log_entries_replayed=5`, `return_delta_vs_actual=0.0598`; ai_judgment/momentum_grace/technical — `scope=lifetime_trade_replay` with cost-drag deltas (ai_judgment `cost_drag_delta=0.0327`).
- **Exit-shadow (observe-only):** rules and ai_judgment `open_count=3` each; momentum_grace and technical `open_count=0`; all tracks `closed_count=0`, `ingested_this_pass=0`.
- **Archive / offline sims:** `history_run_count=7`, `backtest.run_count=7`; simulation tracks over 7 periods (research_overlay `total_return=-0.0817`, momentum_grace `−0.0217`, static/trailing_levels `0.0`); `historical_analysis.top_strategies` populated but `observation_weeks=1`.
- **Rebalance log replay (rules only):** 5/5 log entries replayed; `simulated_return=-0.0253` vs `actual_return_over_window=-0.0851`.

**Missing or thin**

- **Exit-timing cohort artifacts absent:** `exit_timing_cohorts=null`, `exit_timing_near_miss=null` — no hold-recovery vs swap-success readiness counts.
- **Exit-shadow closed cohort:** 0 closed exits on all four tracks; `grace_vs_rotation` counts all zero; note says wait for thicker cohort.
- **Full knob counterfactual P&L:** ai_judgment/momentum_grace/technical previews state replay uses `max_positions` and `sector_cap` only; `min_conviction`, `skip_timing_wait`, and AI gates need archived weekly screens. Rules replay limitation: pre-logging history needs archive lab (L111 reference in payload).
- **Historical depth:** `historical_analysis` window ~8 days; top strategies all `observation_weeks=1`; overlay comparison `downgrade_count=0`, `sample_count=63`.
- **Research overlay signal:** `simulation.comparison_note` — research overlay identical to screen-only over window.
- **Model weights:** `model_weights=null`.
- **Engineering queue:** `open_engineering_tasks=[]`.

sections.automation_risks:
- **Knob auto-apply on thin post-epoch marks:** rules, ai_judgment, and momentum_grace all applied knob changes 2026-08-11 but epoch `equity_marks=0` and benchmark span unavailable — further automated steps would optimize on pre-change P&L mixed into epoch baseline (`learning_tracks_review.reviews.*.metrics.epoch`).
- **Cost drag vs knob tightening:** rules `cost_drag=0.1417` (29 trades) and ai_judgment `cost_drag=0.0668` (11 trades); `churn_health.alerts` flag elevated cost drag on both. Raising `min_conviction` without closed-loop churn evidence may suppress turnover without improving excess (`rules` counterfactual shows cost improvement but still `simulated_return=-0.0253`).
- **Sector-cap tightening on concentrated books:** all three applied tracks cite Communication Services ~34% `max_sector_weight`; tightening `sector_cap` to 0.2 while `positions=3` may force sells without swap-quality evidence.
- **Exit-shadow → knob wiring (L85/N25):** 0 closed exits, 0 grace vs screen_rotation splits — auto-tuning momentum grace from shadow would have no verdict distribution.
- **Breadth expansion while primary underperforms market:** 21 library markets graduated, `observe_sim_markets=["sp500"]`, yet `beat_market=false` on primary track — offline breadth can look productive (`history_run_count=7`) while live learning criterion unmet (`stage_signals.history_run_count=7` is infrastructure depth, not signal proof per fragment theme).
- **Agent/scaling risks:** gap-fill agents blocked (`N21`/`N22` — CURSOR_API_KEY invalid); 26 library memos created last run (`executed=26`) with `estimated_spend_usd=10.4` — scaling research without envelope calibration (L52/N16) risks cost dominance. Cloud-agent dispatch gaps (`frag-20260811-20`) mean ops recovery depends on external cron/PATs, not agent self-trigger.
- **Artifact sync:** compile/dispatch races can desync analysis conclusions from merged code (`frag-20260811-23`, L126) — automated promotion from stale `latest_analysis_review` (2026-08-09, predates 2026-08-11 knob applies) would mis-rank priorities.

sections.fragment_clustering:
### Exit timing, momentum grace, and counterfactual evidence
Archive near-miss sim can seed below-buy-tier priors, but live held/swapped counterfactuals remain thin and exit-shadow has no closed cohorts to score post-exit paths or opportunity cost (`frag-20260811-02`, `03`, `10`, `11`, `12`). Core tension: value downgrade vs rising price — rotate on screen signal vs ride recognition-phase momentum risks winner churn on one side and style drift on the other.

### CI autofix and PR check UX
Ruff autofix on cursor/* PRs works but ~5min lag mimics unresolved failure; pytest and `check_committed_data_json` still need manual or main-branch ci-fix-responder (`frag-20260811-04`, `05`).

- DROP frag-20260811-04 — covered by operational awareness; no distinct deferred item but low strategic priority vs learning gaps.
- PROMOTE frag-20260811-05 → **CI failure taxonomy comment on cursor PRs** — Document which checks autofix covers (ruff only) vs manual (pytest, committed JSON). Revisit when: next cursor/* PR shows red→green after autofix lag.

### Horizon scan and operational rhythm
First horizon scan payload now exists (`run_at=2026-08-12`); operational rhythm (weekly analysis_review + monthly horizon + quarterly deferred-review) still lacks single runbook anchor (`frag-20260811-07`, `08`).

- DROP frag-20260811-07 — first monthly run executing; superseded by this scan.
- DROP frag-20260811-08 — duplicate of open deferred **L124 Unified ops review runbook anchor**.

### Learning cadence, parallel sims, and stage doctrine
Daily paper-auto surveillance outpaces weekly decision-review knob learning; browser sims, archive ftse-simulate, and server learning tracks coexist without one evaluation anchor (`frag-20260811-14`, `15`). Primary track negative excess after costs while library/ops infra advanced — doctrine pause criteria undefined (`frag-20260811-16`).

- PROMOTE frag-20260811-16 → **Explicit stage-2b breadth pause when beat_market=false** — Define whether offline library/observe-sim expansion pauses or continues while `primary_excess_after_costs=-0.0233` and `beat_market=false`. Revisit when: primary track accumulates ≥8 post-knob epoch marks or quarterly deferred-review.

### Ingest metrics and ops monitor
Canonical bootstrap inflates zero-body buy-tier stall counts before depth pays off; ops micro-compile can false-green stalls when engineering queue is empty (`frag-20260811-17`, `19`).

- DROP frag-20260811-17 — duplicate of open deferred **L125 Ingest stall third state**.
- PROMOTE frag-20260811-19 → **Ops monitor false-green escalation policy** — When engineering queue is empty and zero-body count unchanged, define targeted escalation beyond micro-compile pass. Revisit when: eng-20260729-01 CH PDF fetch unparked and zero-body count unchanged (L125 trigger).

### Cloud ops and dispatch dependencies
Cloud agents often cannot `workflow_dispatch`; production ingest/ops depend on cron-job.org PATs and fresh-agent secret injection (`frag-20260811-20`).

### Offline sim promotion and evidence gates
Parallel per-market observe sims lack promotion criteria; `history_run_count=7` is infrastructure not signal (`frag-20260811-21`, `22`).

- DROP frag-20260811-21 — duplicate of open deferred **L127 Offline observe-sim promotion criteria**.
- DROP frag-20260811-22 — subsumed by L127 + `stage_signals.history_run_count` gate.

### Artifact sync and engineering throughput
Compile/dispatch races can desync dashboard/analysis from merged code (`frag-20260811-23`); auto-merge scoped narrowly — ingest/scoring PRs stay human-merge (`frag-20260811-24`).

- DROP frag-20260811-23 — duplicate of open deferred **L126 Analysis-review artifact freshness gate**.

### Research cost scaling and platform ethos
Research spend scales with researched-name count R not universe N; hard weekly cap needed before cap raises (`frag-20260811-25`). Build preference: front-load archive/replay/ingest depth; live-path safety and knob auto-apply remain gated (`frag-20260811-26`).

- PROMOTE frag-20260811-26 → **Platform depth-first investment doctrine (formal)** — Codify that archive replay, ingest depth, and counterfactual utility take precedence over short-term efficiency gates while live automation stays observe-only. Revisit when: L111 archive replay ships first end-to-end counterfactual.
